flow.notes: Previous step lands on shift-your-loan — do not navigate again. Skip path: click Skip then Show My Offers.

flow.name: Select offer
flow.notes: Previous step lands on offer-page — do not navigate again

flow.name: Loan summary
flow.notes: Previous step lands on loan-summary — do not navigate again

flow.name: Book meeting slot

actions.label: First available date on meeting slots calendar
First available Morning or Afternoon time slot on selected date

flow.notes: No-slots fallback: if the selected date shows no Morning/Afternoon time slots, click the next available date in the calendar and select the first available slot — repeat for up to 3 dates. If no date has slots, use emergency booking: click 'Need an emergency slot?', select the first slot in 'Choose Emergency Slots' popup, click 'Book Emergency Slot'. Do not click Continue until a time slot is selected.

flow.name: Booking confirmed — thank you

assertions.label: Our representative will reach out to you shortly to assist you further.

flow.notes: Previous step lands on thank-you — do not navigate again
